commitResults.messageTitle: Level-0 (Renamed Duke to Bryte + Updated docs & agents.md)

commitResults.messageBody: Add a switch statement for commands in anticipation for new commands in the future.

commitResults.messageTitle: feat: add task class for mark as done support
Refactor Java code to follow SE-EDU standard
commitResults.messageBody:
Refactor Bryte.java and Task.java to comply with the SE-EDU Java
Coding Standard (basic + intermediate).

Extracted hardcoded banner strings and array limits into SCREAMING_
SNAKE_CASE constants to eliminate magic values. Renamed variables
(scanner, taskCount, isRunning) to improve clarity and adhere to
naming conventions. Simplified boolean evaluations and standardized
layout to K&R Egyptian-style braces. Added class and method Javadoc
comments to document code intent and API contracts.

commitResults.messageTitle: Update AGENTS.md with project standard mandates
commitResults.messageBody:
Update AGENTS.md to mandate strict adherence to the SE-EDU Java
Coding Standard and SE-EDU Git Standard.

Ensures agents operating in this workspace follow the project-specific
skills for Java coding style and Git commit formatting.

commitResults.messageTitle: feat: add ToDo, Event and Deadline
Refactor Bryte to use extracted command handlers
commitResults.messageBody: This change improves readability by adhering to the Single Level of Abstraction Principle (SLAP) and avoiding excessively long methods.

This change replaces preposition-based variable names ('by', 'from', 'to') with descriptive nouns ('dueDate', 'startTime', 'endTime') to follow the 'Use Nouns for Things' and 'Name well' code quality guidelines.

commitResults.messageTitle: Extract magic strings for command delimiters
commitResults.messageBody: This change replaces hardcoded strings with named constants to follow the 'Avoid Magic Numbers/Strings' guideline, which improves maintainability.
This change renames 'name' to 'description' in Task.java. A task generally has a description of what to do, not just a short 'name'. This follows the 'Use Name to Explain' code quality guideline.
Introduce BryteException to handle specific errors within the Bryte chatbot application, replacing basic error printing with standard exception handling mechanisms.

Update command handlers and main loop to use the custom BryteException. This correctly catches missing descriptions, invalid command formats, and unknown commands, providing clear error messages to the user.
Place BryteException into its own package to separate custom exception handling from the rest of the application.

commitResults.messageTitle: Move Task and its subclasses to bryte.task package
commitResults.messageBody: Group Task, Todo, Deadline, and Event domain model classes into the bryte.task package to improve codebase organization and modularity.

commitResults.messageTitle: Move Bryte to bryte package and add explicit imports
commitResults.messageBody: Place Bryte into the bryte root package and add explicit imports for classes in bryte.exception and bryte.task, adhering to SE-EDU import guidelines.

commitResults.messageTitle: Refactor task list to use ArrayList
commitResults.messageBody: Using Java Collections (ArrayList) allows dynamic sizing and simplifies task addition and removal.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add delete command to remove tasks
commitResults.messageBody: Users can now delete tasks by their list index.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add Javadoc comments for all methods in Bryte class
commitResults.messageBody: Adds method descriptions, @param, and @throws tags to satisfy the SE-EDU Java Coding Standard.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add toFileFormat method to Task and its subclasses
commitResults.messageBody: This will allow tasks to be formatted into a custom string representation for file storage.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add save and load task data feature
commitResults.messageBody: Automatically loads and saves tasks to ./data/bryte.txt
Handles situations where the data file is corrupted by ignoring improperly formatted lines or resetting the task list upon major parsing exceptions.
Resolved conflicts by combining ArrayList updates (from Level 6) with file I/O operations (from Level 7).

commitResults.messageTitle: Add checkstyle configuration and fix styling violations
commitResults.messageBody: Downloads the SE-EDU checkstyle.xml and suppressions.xml, and fixes existing style violations in Bryte.java.

Currently, Bryte handles both application logic and user interaction, which makes it less modular.

Extract a Ui class to handle all user interface concerns, moving closer to the target object-oriented design. Replace static fields and methods in Bryte with instance variables to properly use the new Ui class.

Bryte previously handled low-level file I/O operations directly.

Extract a Storage class to encapsulate file loading and saving. This simplifies Bryte and improves the modularity of the application by delegating data persistence responsibilities to a dedicated class.

Bryte previously managed tasks using an ArrayList directly.

Extract a TaskList class to encapsulate the list of tasks. This hides the internal data structure from Bryte and provides a cleaner domain-specific interface for task management operations.

This adds the Command abstraction and specific concrete command implementations (AddCommand, DeleteCommand, etc.) without integrating them yet. This is preparation for extracting the parsing and execution logic from Bryte.

commitResults.messageTitle: Extract Parser class and integrate Commands
commitResults.messageBody:
Bryte previously handled command parsing and execution within a large run() method.

Extract a Parser class to interpret user input and return the corresponding Command objects. Integrate these objects into Bryte, delegating command execution to the Command classes. This simplifies Bryte and follows the Command pattern.

Previously, deadlines and event times were parsed and stored as raw strings.

Introduce a DateTimeUtil class to parse user input into java.time.LocalDateTime objects. Update Deadline and Event to store LocalDateTime and format it as 'MMM dd yyyy' for display, whilst maintaining compatibility for storage.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add schedule command to search by date
commitResults.messageBody:
View schedule for a specific date.

Add a 'schedule' command that takes a date and prints all deadlines and events occurring on that date. Implement an isOnDate() method on Tasks to facilitate this.

commitResults.messageTitle: Fix EOF crash and ensure date backwards compatibility
commitResults.messageBody:
Ui scanner was crashing on EOF when run non-interactively.

Add check for hasNextLine() to fix the crash. Also update Deadline and Event to fall back to raw strings if date parsing fails, ensuring legacy text file compatibility.
Users can now search for tasks by keyword.

Add Javadoc for all non-private classes and methods, and non-trivial private methods to clarify their purpose, parameters, and behavior.

This improves code readability and ensures API documentation can be cleanly generated without warnings.
Add Javadoc comments across codebase
Document all implemented features in GFMD format, including todo, deadline, event, list, mark, unmark, delete, find, and schedule commands.

commitResults.messageTitle: Enhance User Guide with SE-EDU standard sections
commitResults.messageBody: Add Table of Contents, Quick Start, command format notes, FAQ, and Command Summary while retaining clear example output blocks.

commitResults.messageTitle: Center welcome message and Bryte logo
commitResults.messageBody: Wrap the welcome greeting and ASCII art in an HTML block to ensure both are center-aligned on the User Guide.
Remove anchor link from the welcome text and strip the info emoji from the command notes block.
